name: a-line-doc-documents-a-declaration
query:
apply ~(:double |~~| Doubles the input.
~(mul 2)
| 5 | apply double)

name: a-block-doc-documents-a-declaration
query:
apply ~(:foo |~~ Multi-line doc
    spanning many lines. ~~| 42
| foo)

name: doc-reads-the-block-doc-of-a-declaration-as-its-page
query:
apply ~(:foo |~~ Block doc here. ~~| 42
| ::foo | doc | content)

name: two-line-docs-of-a-slot-join-with-a-line-break-between-them
query:
apply ~(:foo |~~| Doc one.
|~~| Doc two.
42
| ::foo | doc | content)

name: three-line-docs-of-a-slot-make-three-lines-of-the-page
query:
apply ~(:foo |~~| First.
|~~| Second.
|~~| Third.
42
| ::foo | doc | content | lines | count)

name: each-line-doc-of-a-slot-is-an-entry-of-its-own
query:
apply ~(:foo |~~| First.
|~~| Second.
|~~| Third.
42 | env | get /foo | docs | map ~content)

|~~ Block doc. ~~|

42
| ::foo | doc | content | lines | count)

name: doc-block-preserves-newlines
query:
apply ~(:foo |~~ line one
line two ~~| 42
| ::foo | doc | content)

name: a-block-doc-across-lines-is-one-entry-of-the-docs

apply ~(:foo |~~ line one
line two
line three ~~| 42
| env | get /foo | docs | map ~content)

name: a-name-declared-over-the-one-around-holds-its-own-docs
query:
apply ~(:foo |~~| Old.
1
| (:foo |~~| Brand new.
|~~| With extra remark.
2
| env | get /foo | docs | map ~content))

| ::foo | doc | content)

name: doc-block-nests-doc-block-pair

| ::foo | doc | content)

apply ~(:foo |~~ |~~ a ~~| middle |~~ b ~~| ~~| 42
| env | get /foo | docs | map ~content)

| ::foo | doc | content)

name: doc-block-preserves-nested-line-doc-mention

apply ~(:foo |~~ holds |~~| line-doc mention
 more text ~~| 42
| ::foo | doc | content)

name: a-nesting-block-doc-documents-a-declaration-whose-body-is-on-the-next-line
query:

42
| ::foo | doc | content)

name: a-line-comment-opener-inside-a-block-doc-hides-no-closer

apply ~(:foo |~~ pair holds |~| line marker inline ~~|
42
| ::foo | doc | content)

42
| env | get /foo | docs | map ~content)

query:
apply ~(:foo |~~| doc one
|~ separator ~|
|~~| doc two
42
| ::foo | doc | content)

name: the-docs-of-a-slot-join-in-order-across-the-comments-among-them
query:
apply ~(:foo |~~| a
|~ p1 ~|
|~~| b
|~ p2 ~|
|~~| c
42
| ::foo | doc | content)

name: a-block-doc-and-a-line-doc-join-across-a-comment-between-them
query:
apply ~(:bar |~~ block doc ~~|
|~ plain ~|
|~~| line doc
99
| ::bar | doc | content)

name: a-comment-between-a-name-and-its-doc-is-whitespace
query:
apply ~(:foo |~ why ~| |~~| the doc
42
| ::foo | doc | content)

name: a-line-doc-that-holds-a-quote-of-no-code-reads-back-from-its-print
query: "|~~| a ~(b, ~(add 1)) c" | parse | first | eq (print | parse | first)

name: a-line-doc-ends-at-its-line-break-a-carriage-return-before-a-line-feed-left-out-of-its-prose
query: get [~("|~~| x\r\n" | parse | first | content) ~("[|~~| x\r\n 1]" | parse | first | first | content) ~("|~~| a\rb" | parse | first | content)]

name: a-span-between-backquotes-of-a-block-doc-holds-a-doc-nested-in-it
query: |~~ a `f |~~ b ~~| c` then `~(count)` d ~~| | segments

name: a-doc-reads-its-prose-without-the-whitespace-at-its-edges
query: get [~(|~~ A box. ~~| | content) ~(|~~A box.~~| | content) ~(|~~     A box.     ~~| | content)]
